title: Merge overlapping intervals
prompt:
Write mergeIntervals(int[][] intervals) returning a List<List<Integer>> (a List of
two-element Lists, not an int[][]) of the merged intervals, ordered by start ascending.

Each input row is [start, end] with start <= end. Two intervals merge when they overlap
OR merely touch at an endpoint: [1, 4] and [4, 5] become [1, 5], while [1, 4] and [5, 6]
stay apart. The input rows arrive in no particular order. An empty input returns an
empty list.

Examples:
  mergeIntervals([[1, 3], [2, 6], [8, 10]]) -> [[1, 6], [8, 10]]
  mergeIntervals([[5, 6], [1, 2]])          -> [[1, 2], [5, 6]]

Keep the class name Solution and the given method signature.
